scene_summary: A classroom with rows of white desks and swivel chairs, a separate tall table, a wall window and a rear door.
overall_evidence: The reconstruction retains the classroom furniture arrangement and major room features, but presents the scene as a distant exterior cutaway rather than an interior view. Its nearly monochrome surfaces lack the reference's prominent patterned wall tiles, mint upper walls and dark reflective floor. The distant view also makes furniture details difficult to compare.

main_defects.description: The reference is a room-filling interior view at furniture height; the reconstruction is a small elevated exterior cutaway surrounded by dark background, with the roof and outer wall visible.
main_defects.evidence: The classroom fills the reference frame, whereas the reconstructed room occupies only the central part of its image and is viewed from outside.
main_defects.uncertainty: The view difference limits direct judgments about object size and exact placement.

main_defects.description: The distinctive gray patterned lower wall tiles, pale mint upper walls, wood-colored door and dark glossy floor are largely replaced by pale, nearly uniform surfaces.
main_defects.evidence: The reference has a strongly textured gray wall band and deep mirrored floor; the reconstruction shows a faint tile grid and a light floor with much weaker contrast.
main_defects.uncertainty: Bright illumination and the small image scale may wash out some material detail.

main_defects.description: The window appears much smaller relative to the visible wall than the large, wide three-section window in the reference.
main_defects.evidence: The reference window spans a large portion of the left wall and has prominent dark framing; the reconstruction's window is a narrow feature on the back-left wall.
main_defects.uncertainty: Perspective and the exterior cutaway view affect apparent proportions.

main_defects.description: The chairs' visible backs and dark wheeled bases are much less distinct in the reconstruction, where the seating reads as small pale shapes with sparse dark supports.
main_defects.evidence: Several reference chairs have readily visible beige rounded backs and black star-shaped caster bases; only a few small dark base shapes and pale backs are apparent in the reconstruction.
main_defects.uncertainty: The distant view and bright exposure may obscure existing chair geometry.

strengths: The reconstructed scene is recognizably a classroom with multiple white rectangular desks arranged in rows and chairs among them.
A separate narrow table appears on the left, and a framed window and rear door are present.
The floor has some visible reflection, and the room has a lower wall tile band.
uncertainty: This is an initial automated visual estimate, not a human rating or validated aggregate metric. The very different camera views, reconstruction scale and exposure make precise object counts, placement and fine geometry difficult to assess; unseen geometry is not evaluated.
